_about: The sector map for the screen. Every company is placed in exactly one sector, by its main activity. To add a sector, add an entry here (status 'planned' until companies are screened for it) and place companies in config/sector_map.csv. Industry codes are only the fallback: a code says what a company registered as, not what it does.

sectors.name: Fibre networks
sectors.covers: Companies that own or operate fixed fibre networks: full-fibre altnets, wholesale and regional network operators.
sectors.excludes: Fibre build contractors (Network build and maintenance) and resellers of other firms' lines (Business connectivity and communications).

sectors.name: Wireless and mobile networks
sectors.covers: Companies that own or operate wireless networks: managed wifi, fixed wireless access, private mobile networks and IoT connectivity.
sectors.excludes: Towers and small cells (own sector) and mast build contractors (Network build and maintenance).

sectors.name: Towers and small cells
sectors.covers: Owners of passive mobile infrastructure (masts, rooftops, small cells) leased to mobile operators.
sectors.excludes: Companies that only design or build masts.

sectors.name: Data centres and hosting
sectors.covers: Operators of data centres and providers of hosting, colocation and cloud infrastructure.
sectors.excludes: Contractors that build or fit out data centres (Network build and maintenance).

sectors.name: Satellite
sectors.covers: Satellite operators and providers of satellite connectivity.

sectors.name: Critical communications
sectors.covers: Radio, paging and secure communications for emergency services, defence, rail and other users who cannot lose service.

sectors.name: Network build and maintenance
sectors.covers: Contractors that design, build, install and maintain fibre, mobile, utility and data-centre networks for the owners.
measures_to_add: Share of sales from the largest client

sectors.name: Business connectivity and communications
sectors.covers: Providers of connectivity, telephony, mobile and managed network services to businesses and the public sector, mostly over other firms' networks.

sectors.name: Subsea cables
sectors.covers: Owners, operators and maintainers of subsea telecoms cables landing in the UK.
